question.problem:
Consider two sets of $25$ paired observations ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{25},$ and ${y}_{1},{y}_{2},…,{y}_{25}.$ You are given that

$$
\begin{aligned} & {\sum }_{i=1}^{25}{x}_{i}=250, \\  & {\sum }_{i=1}^{25}{y}_{i}=265, \\  & {\sum }_{i=1}^{25}{x}_{i}{y}_{i}=3\,625.\end{aligned}
$$

Then, ${S}_{xy}=$
{{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
Given a set of $n$ paired observations ${x}_{1},{x}_{2},…,{x}_{n}$ and ${y}_{1},{y}_{2},…,{y}_{n},$ the statistic ${S}_{xy}$ be calculated as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{S}_{xy} & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}({x}_{i}-\overset{―}{x})({y}_{i}-\overset{―}{y}) \\  & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{x}_{i}{y}_{i}-\frac{1}{n}({\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{x}_{i})({\sum }_{i=1}^{n}{y}_{i}).\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting the given statistics in the above formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{S}_{xy} & =3\,625-\frac{1}{25}(250)(265) \\  & =3\,625-2\,650 \\  & =975.\end{aligned}
$$
